Re: Deceptive use of Save the Inlet’s name and website

Dear Mr. Kelly:

On behalf of Save the Inlet, I write to inform you that we have learned of a registered website address that deceptively attempts to capitalize on our group’s name and on our website about your organization’s proposal to build luxury high-rise towers at Bushwick Inlet Park. We demand that Gotham take all steps necessary to disable this deceptive address immediately.

As you undoubtedly know, our group created a website last year to provide information to the public about our opposition to the Gotham proposal. The address for that website is savetheinlet.org.
